affected_boundaries: existing active plans to empty durable assignment ledger

observed_behavior: Ordinary advance rejects unassigned active plans before it can establish their assignments.
expected_behavior: Authenticated reconciliation can reserve existing plans without bypassing ordinary advancement checks or fabricating host identities.
causal_mechanism: The only assignment writer occurs after a diagnostic gate that rejects the state requiring adoption, with no recovery operation.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A recovery-required condition blocks the only normal transition that could repair it.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An existing campaign cannot enter the operational scheduler even when its plan records are valid.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Explicit authenticated recovery corrects only its named defect and retains every other safety gate.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Reserve queued V1 assignments under canonical locks; attach host identities only through the ordinary worker handshake.

applicability_conditions: Existing active plan lifecycle records predate their operational assignment ledger.
known_non_matches: Conflicting assignments, missing host observations, and absent coordinator authority remain blocking.
confirmation_evidence: Focused tests reproduce ordinary advance rejection and prove idempotent reservations, conflict refusal, and dependency waits.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: reconciliation reserves existing active plans without fabricating workers and is idempotent
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: campaign reconcile CLI reserves an active leaf once before normal dispatch
